statement: FIFO and pro-rata allocation produce different inventory and adverse-selection exposure under identical public flow and displayed depth.
representation_change: Treat matching allocation as a venue-level experimental factor with explicit rounding and residual rules.
causal_mechanism: Equal-price queue allocation determines which liquidity provider receives toxic and neutral flow, changing inventory and marked wealth.
assumptions: Allocation rules are implemented exactly and agents observe only public feed plus private fills.
predicted_observable: Different fill concentration and inventory-tail distributions at equal aggregate depth.
predicted_direction_or_delta: Unknown sign; not an optimization claim.
cheap_test: Two-maker, one-price-level deterministic allocation and conservation test.
falsifier: Difference disappears after fixing a queue, rounding, or event-order defect.

statement: A public triangular mispricing produces an economic effect only when all three delayed legs have executable depth, fees, and residual exposure accounted.
representation_change: Model an asset graph and a per-leg execution ledger rather than a midpoint parity signal.
causal_mechanism: Cross-pair trades couple liquidity and capital constraints; non-atomic fills turn nominal parity into residual risk.
assumptions: Every settlement denomination has an explicit valuation path.
predicted_observable: All-in cycle edge and terminal wealth differ from midpoint edge; failed legs leave recorded inventory.
predicted_direction_or_delta: Midpoint-only opportunities are rejected more often than they complete.
cheap_test: One deterministic three-book FOK/null scenario with a latency-label swap.
falsifier: Positive result persists after removing executable depth or omits a residual/fee.

statement: Inventory-aware A-S-style controls can reduce inventory tails without reducing useful displayed liquidity or cost-adjusted marked wealth.
representation_change: Evaluate a market maker as an organism with balance sheet, quote survival, fills, markouts, and terminal marked account, not quote counts.
causal_mechanism: Reservation-price skew moves quotes against inventory while volatility/fill-distance spread control prices inventory risk.
assumptions: Observed fill hazard by offset is a usable calibration diagnostic.
predicted_observable: Lower tail inventory conditional on comparable two-sided depth and fill opportunity.
cheap_test: One instrument, same noise path, linear-skew versus A-S maker control.
falsifier: Inventory reduction is entirely caused by cancelled/withdrawn quotes or no valid wealth benefit.

statement: A strategy's risk-normalized marked-equity-share growth depends on opponent composition and can exhibit a stable directed non-transitive cycle.
representation_change: Replace a global strategy ranking with a held-out directed invasion matrix over population mixtures.
causal_mechanism: Liquidity provision, arbitrage, and directional/derivative flow alter each other's available rents, inventory risk, and costs.
assumptions: Capital, risk limits, fees, and reporting numeraire are controlled across candidate populations.
predicted_observable: Significant directional invasion advantages that survive seed/label/order/mixture perturbations.
predicted_direction_or_delta: Unknown; a flat or transitive matrix is an equally valid result.
cheap_test: Two-strategy leave-one-out invasion matrix on a one-asset world.
falsifier: Advantages vanish or reverse on held-out mixtures, or arise from invalid terminal valuation.

statement: An explicit zero option-buy probability must remain zero rather than being conflated with an omitted baseline configuration.
representation_change: Represent optional treatment parameters with presence rather than zero-value sentinel semantics.
causal_mechanism: A zero-value default silently changes the directional-flow treatment, invalidating any gamma-sign or ecology comparison.
assumptions: JSON configuration distinguishes omitted fields from explicit numeric zero through nullable decoding.
predicted_observable: An explicit zero reaches option takers unchanged and omission retains the historical default.
cheap_test: Decode explicit zero and omitted JSON configurations, construct the simulation, and inspect normalized configuration.
falsifier: Explicit zero becomes a nonzero default or omitted configuration changes baseline behavior.

statement: Venue-local matching-rule configuration can select exact existing FIFO or pro-rata algorithms without changing causality outside a named venue.
representation_change: Attach allocation policy to venue identity rather than to an exchange-wide simulation flag.
causal_mechanism: Separate venue allocation rules create distinct equal-price fill incentives while deterministic ingress retains a fixed causal order.
assumptions: The existing matchers are exact for their documented simplified policies.
predicted_observable: A manifest maps each venue to its matcher type; unknown policy or venue fails construction.
cheap_test: Construct north FIFO, central/south pro-rata and inspect concrete matchers; reject invalid rules.
falsifier: Default policy changes, an unknown rule is accepted, or policy map iteration affects construction.
known_failure_modes: Mislabeling basic pro-rata as a real exchange hybrid

statement: A fitness experiment is valid only if every independently funded participant has explicit initial and terminal USD marked accounts.
representation_change: Promote participant identity and marked account rows to controller-owned first-class telemetry.
causal_mechanism: A single dealer account or router cashflow cannot rank an ecology; missing marks must invalidate rather than selectively omit participants.
assumptions: The current control world holds only USD/ABC balances and declares a bootstrap initial mark plus a terminal two-sided ABC/USD mark.
predicted_observable: Strict runs produce one initial and terminal row per participant with role/venue/client identity; an unpriceable terminal book fails.
cheap_test: Three-venue strict active control plus missing-mark and GOMAX invariance regressions.
falsifier: Any connected account is absent, lacks a USD report asset, terminal valuation uses a fallback last trade, or the rows differ across GOMAX settings.
known_failure_modes: Cross-currency asset graph not yet supported
initial bootstrap mark is not an executable mid
